summary: Trigger-index reconciliation implemented as a BeanPostProcessor on MongoDatabaseFactory (justified deviation from the ApplicationRunner plan in Decision 9 — proven necessary by a live boot smoke: auto-index-creation runs during MongoTemplate instantiation, before any ApplicationRunner, and the same-name/different-filter index causes MongoDB error 86 IndexKeySpecsConflict that fails the boot). Idempotent via partialFilterExpression inspection, log-but-never-throw, distinct greppable markers. Cross-file signatures (MongoDatabaseFactory.getMongoDatabase, SimpleMongoClientDatabaseFactory ctor) verified. Single MongoDatabaseFactory bean confirmed (JobRunr creates a MongoClient, not a factory). Live 3-boot smoke + slow ITs + full suite green.

findings.title: BPP once-guard relies on single MongoDatabaseFactory bean
findings.detail: postProcessAfterInitialization fires on the first MongoDatabaseFactory bean and the `reconciled` flag prevents re-entry. Verified there is exactly one such bean (Spring Boot autoconfig); JobRunrMongoConfig contributes a MongoClient, not a factory. Documented in javadoc. No change required.
